'''SomnaSkol Red''' was an alcoholic beverage.

At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dancer in [[Mos Ila]] gave a flask of the beverage to then [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith Apprentice]] [[Darth Nox]] in order to bribe the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] bartender [[Regg]] into revealing the whereabouts of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Andronikos Revel]], saying it was a rare drink.

During the Clone Wars, the liquor was still in circulation and was a favorite of [[environmental hydrographer]] [[Evan Chan]].<ref name="dr">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>

He swore off drinking the beverage after witnessing [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], disguised as an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]], using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] against a security droid at the [[Chancellor Palpatine Spaceport]].<ref name="dr" />
